dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at this unusual bike! The front wheel is huge.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ˈðɪs ʌnˈjuːʒuəl ˈbaɪk! ðə ˈfrʌnt ˈwiːl ɪz ˈhjuːdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's very old. It was built in 1870, and they rebuilt it for the museum.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈoʊld. ɪt wʌz ˈbɪlt ɪn ˌeɪˈtiːn ˈsɛvənti, ənd ðeɪ ˌriːˈbɪlt ɪt fər ðə mjuˈziːəm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Could people really ride it? It looks impossible!
dialogue.reading: kʊd ˈpiːpəl ˈriːli ˈraɪd ɪt? ɪt ˈlʊks ɪmˈpɑːsəbəl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It was difficult, but it wasn't impossible.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt, bʌt ɪt ˈwʌzənt ɪmˈpɑːsəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what's in this room? It looks empty.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌts ɪn ˈðɪs ˈruːm? ɪt ˈlʊks ˈɛmpti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's about light. Some light is invisible to us, but special cameras can see it.
dialogue.reading: ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈlaɪt. sʌm ˈlaɪt ɪz ɪnˈvɪzəbəl tə ʌs, bʌt ˈspɛʃəl ˈkæmərəz kən ˈsiː ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Interesting. Do you think scientists will make people invisible one day?
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. duː juː ˈθɪŋk ˈsaɪəntɪsts wɪl ˈmeɪk ˈpiːpəl ɪnˈvɪzəbəl ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I disagree. Some things are just impossible.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌdɪsəˈɡriː. sʌm ˈθɪŋz ər ˈdʒʌst ɪmˈpɑːsəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: People said flying was impossible, too!
dialogue.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈsɛd ˈflaɪɪŋ wʌz ɪmˈpɑːsəbəl, ˈtuː!
